props.gloss_en: the mishnah: over rain one says 'Who is good and does good'
R' Abbahu (or a baraita): from when does one bless over rain? from when the groom goes out to meet the bride
Rav Yehuda: over rain one says 'we give thanks to You for every drop You brought down for us'
R' Yochanan concludes it: 'were our mouth full of song as the sea ... we could not sufficiently thank You, Lord our God', until 'shall bow'
R' Yochanan: its closing is 'Blessed are You, Lord, abundant thanksgivings'
Rava: say 'the God of thanksgivings'
Rav Pappa: therefore we say both, 'abundant thanksgivings' and 'the God of thanksgivings'
the stam's first answer: the mishnah ('Who is good and does good') is where he heard [that rain fell]; the other where he saw it
the mishnah: over good tidings one says 'Blessed... Who is good and does good'
the stam: both where he saw; the mishnah is where much [rain] came, the other where a little came
the stam, alternatively: both where much came; the mishnah is where he owns land, the other where he does not
the mishnah: one who built a new house or bought new vessels says 'Blessed... Who has given us life... and brought us to this time'
the stam: this [the rain mishnah's 'Who is good and does good'] is where he has partnership
the stam: that [the new-house mishnah's shehecheyanu] is where he has no partnership
the baraita, in sum: over what is his own he says 'Blessed... Who has given us life and sustained us'
the baraita: over what is his and his fellow's he says 'Blessed... Who is good and does good'
wherever no other is with him, one does not say 'Who is good and does good' -- it requires another who shares [the good]
the baraita: if they told him his wife bore a male, he says 'Blessed... Who is good and does good'
the stam: there too his wife is with him, for a male pleases her
the baraita: if his father died and he is his heir, at first he says 'Blessed... the true Judge'
the baraita: and at the end [on inheriting] he says 'Blessed... Who is good and does good'
the stam: there too there are brothers who inherit with him
a change of wine does not require [a new] blessing
a change of place requires [a new] blessing
R' Yochanan: though they said a change of wine needs no blessing, he does say 'Blessed... Who is good and does good'
the stam: there too there are members of the group drinking with him

supports.gloss_en: הלכך נימרינהו לתרוייהו -- since R' Yochanan said 'abundant thanksgivings' and Rava 'the God of thanksgivings', say both
והתניא: קצרו של דבר, על שלו שהחיינו, על שלו ועל של חבירו הטוב והמטיב -- the baraita states the partnership distinction

objections.gloss_en: ועל הגשמים הטוב והמטיב מברך? והאמר רבי אבהו: מאימתי מברכין על הגשמים... מאי מברכין? מודים אנחנו לך (59b.7) -- ואלא קשיא (59b.9). First answered at 59b.9 (heard vs saw = p_okimta_shama), but that answer fell at 59b.10 and was dropped (אלא, 59b.11); the two surviving answers follow

answered_by.gloss_en: אלא: אידי ואידי דחזא מחזי -- הא דאתא פורתא, הא דאתא טובא: both where he saw; R' Abbahu's where a little came, the mishnah's where much came (= p_okimta_tuva)
ואיבעית אימא: הא והא דאתא טובא -- הא דאית ליה ארעא, הא דלית ליה ארעא: both where much came; the mishnah's where he owns land, R' Abbahu's where he does not (= p_okimta_it_lei_ara)

objections.gloss_en: רוב ההודאות ולא כל ההודאות? -- 'abundant thanksgivings' and not 'all thanksgivings'?

answered_by.gloss_en: אמר רבא: אימא האל ההודאות -- say 'the God of thanksgivings' (= p_rava_ha_el_hahodaot)

objections.gloss_en: דשמע משמע היינו בשורות טובות, ותנן: על בשורות טובות אומר ברוך הטוב והמטיב -- hearing of rain is good tidings, which the mishnah already covers
אית ליה ארעא הטוב והמטיב מברך?! והא תנן: בנה בית חדש... אומר שהחיינו; שלו ושל אחרים אומר הטוב והמטיב -- what is his alone takes shehecheyanu

answered_by.gloss_en: לא קשיא: הא דאית ליה שותפות, הא דלית ליה שותפות -- the rain mishnah where he has partnership, the new-house mishnah where he has none (= p_okimta_shutfut, p_okimta_bayit_leit_shutfut)

objections.gloss_en: וכל היכא דלית לאחרינא בהדיה לא מברך הטוב והמטיב? והתניא: אמרו ליה ילדה אשתו זכר, אומר ברוך הטוב והמטיב

answered_by.gloss_en: התם נמי, דאיכא אשתו בהדיה דניחא לה בזכר (= p_okimta_ishto)

objections.gloss_en: תא שמע: מת אביו והוא יורשו, בתחלה אומר דיין האמת ולבסוף הטוב והמטיב

answered_by.gloss_en: התם נמי דאיכא אחי דקא ירתי בהדיה (= p_okimta_achim)

objections.gloss_en: תא שמע: שינוי יין אינו צריך לברך... ואמר רבי יוסף בר אבא אמר רבי יוחנן: אבל אומר ברוך הטוב והמטיב

answered_by.gloss_en: התם נמי, דאיכא בני חבורה דשתו בהדיה (= p_okimta_bnei_chavura)
